title: Clear script device preset
description: Stop re-applying the script device preset after navigation. The current document keeps its script overrides until it navigates or reloads; this call never reloads automatically. Requires an idempotency key.

inputSchema.description: The page whose future script overrides to stop.

pageContextId.description: Opaque context of an agent-owned page.

outputSchema.description: Cleanup receipt; a navigation is still needed to reset current globals.

pageContextId.description: Opaque context of an agent-owned page.

cleared.description: Whether a registered future-navigation preset was removed.

currentDocumentRequiresReload.description: Current script globals reset only when the page navigates or reloads; the call does not reload.
